formal_name: Architecture-Family Exhaustiveness Challenge, Prospective Third-Kernel Construction, Signed Interventional-Kernel Geometry, Rank-3 Latent-Direction Search, Same-(q,g) Action-Splitting Obstruction, Minimal Multi-Family Separating Basis, Kernel-Arrangement Classification, N0<->N1 Boundary Completion & Macro-Architecture Family Census
explanandum: Do N0 and N1 exhaust the architecture space under the frozen scalar q/g/y measurement, and if not, what exact prospective signatures force a third family or failure of the scalar ontology?
primary_interventions: UPSTREAM_DROP: force q 1->0 without directly intervening on y
LOCAL_GATE_DROP: force g 1->0 without directly intervening on y
MATCHED_QG_LATENT_PERTURBATION: alter an admissible non-q/non-g mechanism while holding measured q,g fixed when such an intervention exists

semantic_tiers.strong_scalar_mediation: q and g are each necessary for y and y is deterministic under measured q,g
semantic_tiers.weak_scalar_measurement: q,g,y are measured but q/g necessity and deterministic sufficiency are not assumed
semantic_tiers.structured_gate_extension: g may require a vector G=(g1,...,gm) rather than one scalar coordinate
semantic_tiers.latent_extension: a hidden or omitted coordinate h may affect y while measured q,g remain fixed

falsifiers: Any exact fresh UPSTREAM_DROP vector other than N0 or N1 falsifies strong scalar mediation for that mechanism.
Same measured (q,g) with different y under admissible non-y interventions falsifies deterministic y=f(q,g).
A third linearly independent observed kernel direction is load-bearing only if direct intervention on y and measurement-confounding explanations are excluded.
A multi-gate mechanism with partial upstream coupling may falsify scalar-g exhaustiveness without requiring a latent variable outside the gate structure.
claim_ceiling: No exactly-two-family claim before the scalar-exhaustiveness theorem and fresh obstruction search are both adjudicated.
No rank-3 latent claim from rank alone.
No third-family label for X0/X1 unless the violated semantic axiom is explicitly stated.
No macro law, SOLID derivation, manuscript claim, or LAW-R2 authorization from this stage alone.
freshness_rule: No P28 world candidate may be selected before this constitution and the prospective mathematics are committed.
